searchText: Yes, CL is unaware of this setting. It has a matter for EL clients only as `(block_number; block_hash)` reflects already existing functionality to whitelist a block with exact hash to make EL client sticking with specified chain -- this is required to support `TERMINAL_BLOCK_HASH` override on EL side. CL doesn't need block number to support this override Oh yep, I just saw "`terminalBlockNumber` MUST be set to 0" in the specs 🙏 Luckily I already set it to zero 😎 This string requirement has been removed in this PR as it was a source of confusion, https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/179. Btw, it overlaps a bit with your QoS PR
